rule: A player who collects four of a kind says nothing and quietly puts a hand to their nose. Everyone else simply copies once they notice -- there is nothing to grab. The last player to notice takes one letter of P-I-G, and three letters put you out. The last player left wins. Hands stay at four cards throughout: everyone passes and receives at the same time.
